in_sanskrit.name: Munshi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Scholar, Teacher
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Munshi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Munshi is a Hindi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'muni', meaning wise or learned. The term 'munshi' itself denotes a teacher or a scholar. In Hindu mythology, Munshi is also considered the name of the deity Ganesha in his role as the scribe and recorder of human actions.
